steps.code:

        prompt="Lift the rose",

        name="place_vlabench_entity_in",
        container_name="vase_seen",
        evidence_handles=[handle_vase2],
        use_native_place_point=True,
        prompt="Insert the rose into the vase_seen",
        query="vase_seen",
    )
    print("place ok:", place_res.ok, place_res.error if not place_res.ok else "placed")
